initial_executor.limitations: Evidence is mixed; some supplements (e.g., vitamin C/E, n-3 LCPUFAs) showed no benefit or increased oxidative stress in specific studies. Benefits are often conditional on dosage, population (e.g., young soccer players, master athletes), or specific outcomes (e.g., lipid peroxidation vs. inflammation). Some items are mentioned as having antioxidant properties or being studied, but direct efficacy in athletes is not universally confirmed across all evidence segments.
